verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer documents Autofix, which scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage (sentry-docs-5/30/34/53). The homepage claims it can "automatically root-cause any issue" (sentry-docs-17). Seer Agent can also answer questions using telemetry, and Autofix can generate a fix PR (sentry-docs-31, sentry-docs-34). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of root-cause accuracy, and in-depth documentation of how the investigation works and is triggered from alerts (evidence is short marketing/docs snippets only).
